🤖 **Agent note** · blocked on a dependency — task 18822 (lane code-e)
- **Fresh state (2026-11-17):** issue #9071 OPEN, labels kind/feature + app/pm-stack, no hard-stop labels. It is Phase 3 of the pm-board hierarchy design (doc/2026-11-12T22-50-00Z_design_pm-board-hierarchy-genealogy/note.md §6).
- **The gate:** the first acceptance item — the genealogy header on /item/<subject> — is "fed by ItemExtras.genealogy **from the genealogy read model**". That read model is issue **#9070** (impl(pm-stack): genealogy read model — ancestors, spawned-by, sentence renderer, API), verified **OPEN** today. The header cannot be built or honestly degraded without the read model's data shape, and the remaining surfaces (per-project roadmap drill machinery, priorities view) are specified against the same Phase 3 read-model contracts. Building Phase 3 first would mean inventing the ItemExtras.genealogy shape and reworking it when #9070 lands.
- **Upstream note:** #9070 itself sits behind #9066 (primary-parent convention + historical link semantics, also OPEN) — that is #9070's gate to resolve in its own triage, not a second blocker recorded here.
- **Action:** labels queue/blocked + status/blocked applied; task 18822 blocked with reason class dependency, broker-tracked on issue #9070. When #9070 closes, this returns to the queue and Phase 3 can be packeted against the real read-model API.

<!-- agent-note:v1 agent=repo-queue-worker lane=code-e state=blocked-correction at=2026-11-17T04:56Z -->

🤖 **Agent note** · correction to the note above — task 18822 (lane code-e)
- The dependency verdict stands (Phase 3 is gated on the #9070 genealogy read model, OPEN), and the issue-side state is applied: labels queue/blocked + status/blocked are set, and the reasoning is on the record above.
- **Correction:** the queue-side dep-block could not be applied. When the block verb was called with the correct form (`--blocked-by-issue developing-today/code#9070 --dep-max-ttl-seconds 259200`), the broker answered "task 18822 is not claimed by repo-worker-code" — the claim had been displaced/released between claim (04:43Z) and the block call, and the task no longer appears in any status list readable from this lane. So there is **no live broker dep-block** on task 18822 despite the note above saying one was recorded; the blocked state currently lives on this issue's labels + notes only.
- **For the next lane that claims the replacement triage/fix work for #9071:** treat the gate as real — re-declare the dep-block on #9070 under your own claim, or proceed only if #9070 has closed by then.

<!-- agent-note:v1 agent=repo-worker-code lane=any-n state=triaged task=18822 origin=openchamber-scheduled-lane at=2026-11-19T22:53Z -->

🤖 **Agent note** · dependency cleared → routed as implementation — task 18822 (lane any-n)

- **Fresh revalidation (2026-11-19T22:42–22:48Z):** issue **#9070** (genealogy read model — the Phase 3 gate) is **CLOSED** `status:done`, merged via **PR #12070** (merge commit `6b9e65f68`, 2026-11-19), landing `pm-stack/aggregator/src/genealogy.ts`, `ancestors[]` + `release` on `/api/item/<id>.json`, and `priority`/`after`/`release` refs on `/api/roadmap.json`.
- The earlier dep-block verdict from lane code-e (2026-11-17) is therefore **stale**; its `status/blocked` + `queue/blocked` labels are removed and `queue/queued` is set in this pass.
- **Follow-on:** queued task **20861** in `repo-health-code-pilot` — scoped implementation of #9071's four surfaces (genealogy header, per-project roadmap, overall priorities, releases) against the real read-model shape per the design's Pages recipe (PageDef + render fn + route + API twin).
